assumptions.choice: Fixed volume is calculated on the first bar as 1% of initial capital divided by the initial close price.
assumptions.reason: The spec states to use a fixed volume (for example 1% of initial capital). Computing fixed share count at strategy start guarantees constant unit sizing across all entries.

assumptions.choice: When price opens or moves straight to >= 5% profit before break-even partial exit was processed, close 62.5% of open size (25% for break-even plus 50% of the remaining 75%).
assumptions.reason: Combining both partial exit rules into a single order when both profit thresholds are satisfied prevents order collision in Backtrader while respecting both fractional exit conditions.

assumptions.choice: Partial exit flags are reset when a new pyramiding position is opened.
assumptions.reason: Pyramiding updates the position size and average entry price. Evaluating total profit across all open lots requires resetting partial exit checks for the newly combined average entry price.
